$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-15 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-169. Wall-clock time in an IANA zone → UTC instant (FR-ACC-11, domain model P7). DST rules follow RFC 5545 3.3.5: a local time that does not exist (spring-forward gap) is interpreted with the UTC offset in effect before the gap, so it moves forward; an ambiguous local time (fall-back overlap) means its first occurrence. Used to derive event start_utc/end_utc and to place timed events on the viewer's days.
purpose: Converts a local date and time in an IANA time zone into the UTC instant it denotes, reporting the offset used and whether a DST gap or overlap was resolved.

errors.when: tzid is not an IANA zone

invariants: exact: the local time exists exactly once; converting the result back to the zone yields the input
gap_shifted: the local time does not exist; the offset in effect before the gap is used, so the result shown in the zone is later than the input by the size of the gap
overlap_first: the local time exists twice; the earlier instant (offset before the transition) is returned
the result does not depend on the host time zone or locale
dates are proleptic Gregorian; leap days are valid only in leap years
